title: NC/custom-license + redistribution policy (COSMIC/OncoKB handling)
context: Defines how non-commercial/custom-licensed sources (notably COSMIC and OncoKB) and redistribution are handled so the gate's license check is objective and consistent. Binding cancer guardrails apply: open-access / aggregate / de-identified data only; controlled-access (dbGaP, EGA, ICGC DACO, individual-level biobanks) and any identifiable patient data are OUT OF SCOPE; COSMIC/OncoKB are non-commercial/custom (flag, never treat as open); no medical advice; provenance on every assertion. Depends on the licensing matrix.
objective: Document the NC/custom-license and redistribution policy that the gate's license check escalates to, including when a source is FLAGGED vs EXCLUDED.
acceptanceCriteria: Policy states COSMIC and OncoKB (and any NC/custom-licensed source) are flagged/escalated and never treated as open or admitted to the do-first pool.
Defines redistribution rules: we document but never host/mirror/redistribute the data itself; only license-text snapshots and cited clauses are captured.
Gives the objective FLAG vs EXCLUDE decision rule the gate's license check cites, with worked examples.
Policy is versioned and cross-referenced from license-matrix-005 and gate-004.
